name: lofi-bedroom-couple-photobooth
image_purpose: Couple memory post and photobooth collage

prompt.project_info: Create one vertical 3:4 image containing three stacked webcam-style frames of two approved adults sharing a cute bedroom photobooth moment.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman in a pink tank top and approved adult man in a black hoodie with hood up. Frame 1: he hugs from behind near her cheek while she points to it and pouts. Frame 2: she faces camera calmly with a soft pink heart sticker above her while he looks at her. Frame 3: she touches her lips and he looks toward camera. Keep all interaction affectionate and non-explicit.
prompt.composition_elements: Three horizontal frames stacked vertically as a single 3:4 collage, tight head-and-shoulders laptop-webcam perspective, cozy bedroom at night with bed and pillows softly visible. Add one soft pink heart sticker in frame 2 only.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim warm bedroom lighting, low-light digital noise, soft shadows, muted beige, pink and black palette, slight webcam compression and barrel distortion.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic webcam photobooth look, wide-ish webcam lens, 3:4 vertical collage, soft readable faces, subtle vignette, no studio sharpness.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 three-frame webcam photobooth collage of two approved adults in a cozy bedroom at night. The woman wears a pink tank top and the man wears a black hoodie with hood up. Frame 1: he hugs from behind near her cheek while she points to her cheek and makes a playful pout. Frame 2: she faces the camera calmly, he looks at her affectionately, and one soft pink heart sticker floats above her. Frame 3: she touches her lips with her fingers while he looks toward the camera. Bed and pillows softly visible, dim warm light, low-light digital noise, webcam softness, slight barrel distortion, cute intimate casual mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, nudity, graphic sexual content, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted faces, extra fingers, text, logos, watermark
